gallery.title: File:130529-N-SO584-046 (8878918468).jpg
gallery.description: 130529-N-SO584-046 JAKARTA, Indonesia (May 29, 2013) Kristen Bauer Deputy Chief of Mission at the U. S. Embassy in Jakarta briefs U.S. Navy and Republic of Indonesia Sailors at the closing ceremonies of Corporation Afloat Readiness and Training (CARAT) Indonesia 2013. More than 1,000 Sailors and Marines are participating in CARAT Indonesia 2013. U.S. Navy ships participating in the exercise include the amphibious dock landing ship USS Tortuga (LSD 46), the diving and salvage vessel USNS Safeguard (T-ARS 50) with embarked Mobile Diving and Salvage Unit (MDSU) 1, and the guided missile destroyer USS Momsen (DDG 92). (Photo by Mass Communication Specialist1st Class Jimmie Crockett. /RELEASED)
categories: Flickr images reviewed by File Upload Bot (Magnus Manske)

gallery.title: File:130424-N-YU572-054 (8872260850).jpg
gallery.description: JAKARTA, Indonesia (May 24, 2013) Sailors aboard the guided missile destroyer USS Momsen (DDG 92) stow mooring lines after getting underway in support of Cooperation Afloat Readiness and Training (CARAT) Indonesia 2013.  More than 1,000 Sailors and Marines are participating in CARAT Indonesia.  U.S. Navy ships participating in the exercise include the salvage and recovery ship USNS Safeguard (T-ARS 50) with embarked Mobile Diving and Salvage Unit (MDSU) 1, amphibious dock landing ship USS Tortuga (LSD 46), and Momsen.  CARAT is a series of bilateral military exercises between the U.S. Navy and the armed forces of Bangladesh, Brunei, Cambodia, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Timor Leste.  (U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist 1st Class Jay C. Pugh/Released)

Fadhil! Huh? Where are you going? I want to cross the road. You are a lost kid, yeah. Where is your mother? She is working. Your mother still works at night?? Where's your mother? Huh? [inaudible]
